2	
3	## Purpose
4	
5	Lets one administrator sign in with the token configured in the server's environment and keeps that session
6	in a signed `httpOnly` cookie, so the admin endpoints answer only to a valid session while the storefront
7	stays public.
8	
9	## ADDED Requirements
10	
11	### Requirement: Admin token configuration
12	`AppConfig` SHALL carry `adminToken`: the value of `ADMIN_TOKEN`, read only in `apps/api/src/config.ts`;
13	`undefined` when the variable is unset or blank (empty or whitespace only). An undefined token means "admin
14	not configured" and SHALL NOT fail startup — the storefront works without an admin.
15	
16	#### Scenario: Config reads ADMIN_TOKEN
17	- **WHEN** `loadConfig({})` is called
18	- **THEN** `adminToken` is `undefined`
19	- **WHEN** `loadConfig({ ADMIN_TOKEN: "secret-token" })` is called
20	- **THEN** `adminToken` is `"secret-token"`
21	- **WHEN** `loadConfig({ ADMIN_TOKEN: "   " })` is called
22	- **THEN** `adminToken` is `undefined`
23	
24	### Requirement: Admin login
25	`POST /api/admin/login` with JSON body `{ token }` SHALL answer, in this order of checks: 400
26	`{ error: "Invalid request body" }` when the body is not JSON or `token` is not a string; 503
27	`{ error: "Admin is not configured" }` when `adminToken` is undefined; 401 `{ error: "Invalid token" }` when
28	`token !== adminToken`; otherwise 204 with an empty body and the header
29	`Set-Cookie: admin_session=admin.<signature>; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` (12 hours),
30	where `<signature>` is the URL-encoded base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the value `admin` keyed with `adminToken`.
31	No `Set-Cookie` header is sent on 400, 401 or 503.
32	
33	#### Scenario: Login with the right token sets the session cookie
34	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/login` with header `Content-Type: application/json` and body
35	  `{ "token": "secret-token" }` is requested through `createApp({ ..., adminToken: "secret-token" }).request()`
36	- **THEN** the status is 204, `await res.text()` is `""` and the response header `Set-Cookie` equals exactly
37	  `admin_session=admin.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`
38	  (`YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0=` is
39	  `createHmac("sha256", "secret-token").update("admin").digest("base64")`, URL-encoded)
40	
41	#### Scenario: Login with a wrong token
42	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/login` with body `{ "token": "wrong-token" }` is requested on the app configured
43	  with `adminToken: "secret-token"`
44	- **THEN** the status is 401, the body is `{ error: "Invalid token" }` and there is no `Set-Cookie` header
45	
46	#### Scenario: Login without a configured token
47	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/login` with body `{ "token": "secret-token" }` is requested on an app created with
48	  `adminToken: undefined`
49	- **THEN** the status is 503, the body is `{ error: "Admin is not configured" }` and there is no `Set-Cookie`
50	  header
51	
52	#### Scenario: Login body without a token is rejected
53	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/login` with body `{ "password": "secret-token" }` is requested on the app
54	  configured with `adminToken: "secret-token"`
55	- **THEN** the status is 400 and the body is `{ error: "Invalid request body" }`
56	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/login` with the non-JSON body `not json` is requested on the same app
57	- **THEN** the status is 400, the body is `{ error: "Invalid request body" }` and there is no `Set-Cookie`
58	  header
59	
60	### Requirement: Admin logout
61	`POST /api/admin/logout` SHALL answer 204 with an empty body and the header
62	`Set-Cookie: admin_session=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`, whether or not the request carries
63	a session cookie. It needs no session.
64	
65	#### Scenario: Logout clears the cookie
66	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/logout` is requested with header
67	  `Cookie: admin_session=admin.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D` (the cookie of a successful
68	  login on the app configured with `adminToken: "secret-token"`)
69	- **THEN** the status is 204, `await res.text()` is `""` and the response header `Set-Cookie` equals exactly
70	  `admin_session=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`
71	- **WHEN** `POST /api/admin/logout` is requested with no `Cookie` header
72	- **THEN** the status is 204 and `Set-Cookie` equals the same header
73	
74	### Requirement: Session check
75	`GET /api/admin/session` SHALL answer 200 `{ authenticated: true }` when the admin is configured and the
76	request carries an `admin_session` cookie whose signature verifies with `adminToken` and whose value is
77	`admin`; otherwise 200 `{ authenticated: false }`. It SHALL never answer 401.
78	
79	#### Scenario: Session reflects the cookie
80	- **WHEN** `GET /api/admin/session` is requested with no `Cookie` header on the app configured with
81	  `adminToken: "secret-token"`
82	- **THEN** the status is 200 and the body is `{ authenticated: false }`
83	- **WHEN** `GET /api/admin/session` is requested with header
84	  `Cookie: admin_session=admin.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D` (the `Set-Cookie` of a login
85	  on the same app, the part before the first `;`)
86	- **THEN** the status is 200 and the body is `{ authenticated: true }`
87	- **WHEN** the same request with that cookie is made on an app created with `adminToken: undefined`
88	- **THEN** the status is 200 and the body is `{ authenticated: false }`
89	
90	### Requirement: Admin routes require the session cookie
91	Every `/api/admin/*` route other than `POST /api/admin/login`, `POST /api/admin/logout` and
92	`GET /api/admin/session` SHALL answer 401 `{ error: "Unauthorized" }` — before any parsing or lookup —
93	unless the request carries an `admin_session` cookie whose signature verifies with `adminToken` and whose
94	value is `admin`. When no `adminToken` is configured, no cookie verifies.
95	
96	#### Scenario: Missing cookie is unauthorized
97	- **WHEN** on the snapshot-mode app configured with `adminToken: "secret-token"` and with no `Cookie` header,
98	  these are requested: `GET /api/admin/settings`; `PUT /api/admin/settings` with body
99	  `{ "dataSource": "live" }`; `GET /api/admin/products`;
100	  `PUT /api/admin/products/karashynyard:1498486363994/visibility` with body `{ "visible": false }`
101	- **THEN** each answers 401 with the body `{ error: "Unauthorized" }`
102	- **AND** a following `GET /api/products` still answers `source: "snapshot"` with 20 products (nothing was
103	  applied)
104	
105	#### Scenario: Tampered cookie is unauthorized
106	- **WHEN** `GET /api/admin/settings` is requested on the app configured with `adminToken: "secret-token"`
107	  with header `Cookie: admin_session=root.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D` (the login cookie
108	  with its value changed and its signature kept)
109	- **THEN** the status is 401 and the body is `{ error: "Unauthorized" }`
110	- **WHEN** the same request is made with header
111	  `Cookie: admin_session=admin.%2FPIVjLj4NPDY7r3QD9XpFnAbAO6%2F%2BG9MWfTiAQpvCdg%3D` (the value `admin`
112	  signed with `"other-secret"`)
113	- **THEN** the status is 401 and the body is `{ error: "Unauthorized" }`
114	- **WHEN** the same request is made with header `Cookie: admin_session=admin.garbage`
115	- **THEN** the status is 401 and the body is `{ error: "Unauthorized" }`
116	
117	#### Scenario: Valid cookie passes the guard
118	- **WHEN** after `POST /api/admin/login` with body `{ "token": "secret-token" }`, the `Set-Cookie` value up
119	  to the first `;` (`admin_session=admin.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D`) is sent back as the
120	  `Cookie` header of `GET /api/admin/settings` on the same app (snapshot mode, settings store on an empty
121	  temp directory with defaults `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`)
122	- **THEN** the status is 200 and the body is
123	  `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`
124	
125	#### Scenario: Unconfigured admin rejects every cookie
126	- **WHEN** `GET /api/admin/settings` is requested with header
127	  `Cookie: admin_session=admin.YbVzf199LMuIAnqKLH3KL2DLV4kY4JiTTy8hVnqndK0%3D` on an app created with
128	  `adminToken: undefined`
129	- **THEN** the status is 401 and the body is `{ error: "Unauthorized" }`

1	# Spec Delta
2	
3	## Purpose
4	
5	Keeps the administrator's choices — which data source the catalog serves and which products of each shop the
6	storefront shows — in one JSON file, applies them to the catalog at once, and exposes them through the admin
7	endpoints: read and change the source, list every product with its visibility, toggle one product.
8	
9	## ADDED Requirements
10	
11	### Requirement: Settings file and defaults
12	The admin settings SHALL be the object
13	`{ dataSource: "live" | "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: string[] | null, osio: string[] | null } }`
14	(`null` = that shop's default, the first ten products in upstream order; an array = the product ids the
15	admin chose), persisted in one JSON file whose path the store receives as a constructor value together with
16	the defaults (`<dataDir>/admin-settings.json` in production; `dataSource` from config, both shops `null`).
17	A missing file SHALL read as the defaults and SHALL NOT be created by a read; a file that fails the schema
18	SHALL be an error, never silently replaced. Every write SHALL replace the file atomically (temporary file in
19	the same directory, then rename).
20	
21	#### Scenario: Missing file reads as defaults
22	- **WHEN** a store is created on `<tmp>/admin-settings.json` (`<tmp>` a fresh empty temp directory) with the
23	  defaults `{ dataSource: "live", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }` and `read()` is awaited
24	- **THEN** it resolves to `{ dataSource: "live", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }` and the
25	  directory listing of `<tmp>` is `[]` (no file was created)
26	
27	#### Scenario: Reads persisted settings
28	- **WHEN** `<tmp>/admin-settings.json` contains
29	  `{"dataSource":"snapshot","visibility":{"karashynyard":["karashynyard:1743423686258","karashynyard:1498486363994"],"osio":null}}`
30	  and a store on that path with the defaults above awaits `read()`
31	- **THEN** it resolves to
32	  `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: ["karashynyard:1743423686258", "karashynyard:1498486363994"], osio: null } }`
33	
34	#### Scenario: Update writes atomically
35	- **WHEN** on a store over an empty temp directory with the defaults above
36	  `update((current) => ({ ...current, dataSource: "snapshot" }))` is awaited
37	- **THEN** the callback received `current` equal to the defaults, the call resolves to
38	  `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`, the directory listing of
39	  `<tmp>` is exactly `["admin-settings.json"]` (no temporary file left behind),
40	  `JSON.parse(readFileSync("<tmp>/admin-settings.json", "utf8"))` deep-equals that object, and a following
41	  `read()` resolves to the same object
42	
43	#### Scenario: Invalid file content is an error
44	- **WHEN** `<tmp>/admin-settings.json` contains `{"dataSource":"foo"}` and a store on that path awaits
45	  `read()`
46	- **THEN** the promise rejects with an `Error` and the file is left unchanged (its text is still
47	  `{"dataSource":"foo"}`)
48	
49	### Requirement: Persisted data source overrides the environment at startup
50	At startup the server SHALL read the settings store (defaults built from `config.dataSource`) and start the
51	catalog in the `dataSource` it returns: the persisted value when the file exists, `DATA_SOURCE` otherwise.
52	A settings file that cannot be read SHALL fail startup instead of silently serving the default.
53	
54	#### Scenario: Persisted data source overrides DATA_SOURCE
55	- **WHEN** `<tmp>/admin-settings.json` contains
56	  `{"dataSource":"snapshot","visibility":{"karashynyard":null,"osio":null}}`, a store on that path is created
57	  with the defaults `{ dataSource: loadConfig({}).dataSource, visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`
58	  (that is `"live"`), `settings = await store.read()`, a catalog with fake adapters is created with
59	  `source: settings.dataSource` and that store as its `settings`, and `GET /api/products` is requested
60	  through `app.request()`
61	- **THEN** `settings.dataSource` is `"snapshot"`, `catalog.getSource()` is `"snapshot"`, the response has
62	  `source: "snapshot"`, both shops `status: "snapshot"` with `count: 10`, and neither fake adapter was called
63	- **WHEN** the same store is created over an empty temp directory
64	- **THEN** `store.read()` resolves with `dataSource: "live"`
65	
66	### Requirement: Read the settings
67	`GET /api/admin/settings` SHALL answer 200 with the current settings object exactly as the store reads it.
68	
69	#### Scenario: Settings on a fresh install
70	- **WHEN** `GET /api/admin/settings` is requested with a valid session cookie on an app in `snapshot` mode
71	  whose settings store is on an empty temp directory with the defaults
72	  `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`
73	- **THEN** the status is 200 and the body is
74	  `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`
75	
76	### Requirement: Change the data source
77	`PUT /api/admin/settings` with body `{ dataSource }` (`"live"` or `"snapshot"`, no other keys) SHALL
78	persist the value, switch the catalog to it before answering, and answer 200 with the settings object; the
79	next `GET /api/products` has `source` equal to the new value. Any other body — not JSON, missing or invalid
80	`dataSource`, extra keys — SHALL answer 400 `{ error: "Invalid request body" }` and change nothing.
81	
82	#### Scenario: Switch to snapshot applies immediately
83	- **WHEN** on an app in `live` mode (fake adapters resolving their 10 snapshot products, settings store on an
84	  empty temp directory with defaults `{ dataSource: "live", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`),
85	  `PUT /api/admin/settings` with a valid session cookie and body `{ "dataSource": "snapshot" }` is requested,
86	  then `GET /api/products`
87	- **THEN** the PUT answers 200 with `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`;
88	  the GET answers `source: "snapshot"`, `shops[0]` equal to
89	  `{ key: "karashynyard", name: "Карашин Яр", url: "https://karashynyard.com.ua/#rec638772397", status: "snapshot", count: 10 }`,
90	  `shops[1].status` `"snapshot"`, and neither fake adapter was called
91	- **AND** `JSON.parse(readFileSync("<tmp>/admin-settings.json", "utf8")).dataSource` is `"snapshot"` and
92	  `GET /api/admin/settings` with the cookie answers the same settings object
93	
94	#### Scenario: Switch back to live
95	- **WHEN** after the previous scenario `PUT /api/admin/settings` with the cookie and body
96	  `{ "dataSource": "live" }` is requested, then `GET /api/products`
97	- **THEN** the PUT answers 200 with `{ dataSource: "live", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`,
98	  the GET answers `source: "live"` with `shops[0].status` `"live"` and `shops[1].status` `"live"`, `count: 10`
99	  each, and each fake adapter has been called exactly once
100	
101	#### Scenario: Invalid settings body
102	- **WHEN** with a valid session cookie on the snapshot-mode app, `PUT /api/admin/settings` is requested with
103	  body `{ "dataSource": "foo" }`
104	- **THEN** the status is 400 and the body is `{ error: "Invalid request body" }`
105	- **WHEN** it is requested with body `{}`
106	- **THEN** the status is 400 and the body is `{ error: "Invalid request body" }`
107	- **WHEN** it is requested with body `{ "dataSource": "live", "visibility": { "karashynyard": [] } }`
108	- **THEN** the status is 400 and the body is `{ error: "Invalid request body" }` (only `dataSource` is
109	  accepted here)
110	- **WHEN** it is requested with the non-JSON body `not json`
111	- **THEN** the status is 400, the body is `{ error: "Invalid request body" }`, and `GET /api/admin/settings`
112	  still answers `{ dataSource: "snapshot", visibility: { karashynyard: null, osio: null } }`
113	
114	### Requirement: List every product with its visibility
115	`GET /api/admin/products` SHALL answer 200 with
116	`{ source, shops: [{ key, name, url, status, error?, total, visible }], products: [{ ...Product, visible }] }`:
117	`products` holds **every** product the catalog currently has for each shop, in upstream order, shops in
118	configured order — in `live` mode the full adapter result (or the full snapshot when the shop fell back), in
119	`snapshot` mode the full snapshot; `visible` is computed from the settings (`null` → the first ten `true`,
120	the rest `false`; an array → `true` when the id is in it); `total` is the length of the shop's full list and
121	`visible` the number of its products with `visible: true`; `status` and `error` are the catalog's.
122	
123	#### Scenario: Live mode lists products beyond the first ten

125	  `{ ok: true, products }` with its 10 snapshot products followed by sourceIds `1629901938947`
126	  ("Філе зі стегна індички, 1 кг", 665) and `1636965991022` ("Стегно індички, 1 кг", 595), the fake osio
127	  adapter returns its 10 snapshot products, the settings are the defaults, and `GET /api/admin/products` is
128	  requested
129	- **THEN** the status is 200, `source` is `"live"`, `shops` equals
130	  `[ { key: "karashynyard", name: "Карашин Яр", url: "https://karashynyard.com.ua/#rec638772397", status: "live", total: 12, visible: 10 }, { key: "osio", name: "OSIO organic", url: "https://osio-organic.com.ua/", status: "live", total: 10, visible: 10 } ]`
131	  (no `error` keys), `products.length` is 22, `products[0]` equals the full `karashynyard:1498486363994`
132	  Product (price 665) plus `visible: true`, `products[9]` is `id: "karashynyard:1743423686258"`,
133	  `visible: true`, `products[10]` is `id: "karashynyard:1629901938947"`, `name: "Філе зі стегна індички, 1 кг"`,
134	  `price: 665`, `visible: false`, `products[11]` is `id: "karashynyard:1636965991022"`, `price: 595`,
135	  `visible: false`, `products[12]` is `id: "osio:6abcf192b7db2532803d266d"`, `visible: true` and
136	  `products[21]` is `id: "osio:69e5236361852dec4059d4e8"`, `visible: true`

138	#### Scenario: Snapshot mode with a visibility array
139	- **WHEN** on an app in `snapshot` mode whose settings file holds
140	  `{"dataSource":"snapshot","visibility":{"karashynyard":["karashynyard:1743423686258","karashynyard:1498486363994"],"osio":null}}`,

179	### Requirement: Admin functions of the API client
180	`src/api/client.ts` SHALL export `getAdminSession()` (`GET /api/admin/session`), `adminLogin(token)`
181	(`POST /api/admin/login`, body `{ token }`, resolves `undefined` on 204), `adminLogout()`
182	(`POST /api/admin/logout`, resolves `undefined`), `getAdminSettings()` (`GET /api/admin/settings`),
183	`updateSettings({ dataSource })` (`PUT /api/admin/settings`, body `{ dataSource }`), `getAdminProducts()`
184	(`GET /api/admin/products`) and `setProductVisibility(id, visible)`
185	(`PUT /api/admin/products/<id>/visibility`, body `{ visible }`). The `id` in that path SHALL be
186	percent-encoded by the same rule as the basket item paths of `add-basket`'s "Basket functions of the API
187	client": `encodeURIComponent` except the `:` between shop key and source id, which stays literal
188	(`ProductIdSchema` permits `#`, `?` and `%`, which would otherwise truncate or corrupt the path). Each
189	function goes through the same request helper as the basket functions: `fetch` with
190	`credentials: "same-origin"`, a JSON `Content-Type` header only when a body is sent, a 2xx JSON body
191	validated with the shared schema; a non-2xx answer rejects with an `Error` whose message is
192	`<METHOD> <path> failed: <status>` and whose `status` property is the HTTP status, so the page can tell 401
193	from 503. Components never call `fetch`.

201	  `"/api/admin/login"` and an init whose `method` is `"POST"`, `credentials` is `"same-origin"`, `headers`
